changelog:
- Initial release of the agentic commerce toolkit for end-to-end Lightning Network payments.
- Provides automated workflows for setting up a Lightning node (lnd), HTTP payment fetcher (lnget), and paywall proxy (aperture).
- Enables buying and selling of data via the L402 protocol, supporting agent-to-agent micropayments.
- Includes detailed setup steps for wallet creation, channel funding, and endpoint configuration.
- Offers security guidelines and controls for operational safety in agent-based commerce.
summary: End-to-end agentic commerce workflow using Lightning Network. Use when an agent needs to set up a full payment stack (lnd + lnget + aperture), buy or sell data via L402, or enable agent-to-agent micropayments.
